places.name: FlowbindQualityResultKnown
places.description: Boundary input: a whole Flowbind lot whose Quality decision is already known; quarantine waiting and checks are not yet simulated.

places.name: ReleasedFlowbindLots
places.description: Whole Flowbind lots Quality passed and released to usable warehouse stock; sum their units for represented usable stock (not the full Site 1000 inventory).

places.name: DisposedFlowbindLots
places.description: Rejected Flowbind lots removed and disposed of; their recorded costs are outside this fragment.

places.name: OpenFlowbindOrders
places.description: Outstanding Flowbind units still in the open-order bucket; exclude units already booked into quarantine.

places.name: QuarantinedFlowbind
places.description: Arrived Flowbind units booked into quarantine before Quality outcome is known; excludes units separately represented at the known-result boundary.

transitions.name: Release passed Flowbind lot
transitions.description: Routes a lot with a completed passing Quality result into usable stock; does not simulate Quality's time or decision.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const lot = input.FlowbindQualityResultKnown[0];
return { ReleasedFlowbindLots: [{ lot_id: lot.lot_id, qc_pass: true, units: lot.units }] };

transitions.name: Dispose rejected Flowbind lot
transitions.description: Routes a lot with a completed failed Quality result to permanent disposal; does not calculate recorded costs.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const lot = input.FlowbindQualityResultKnown[0];
return { DisposedFlowbindLots: [{ lot_id: lot.lot_id, qc_pass: false, units: lot.units }] };

types.name: Flowbind lot with Quality result
types.description: One whole Flowbind lot with externally known Quality result and its amount in Site 1000 material units; check time and decision are outside the fragment.

types.name: Flowbind supply amount
types.description: A separately tracked Flowbind supply quantity in Site 1000 units; identity helps distinguish booking categories.

metrics.name: Released Flowbind units
metrics.description: Total usable Flowbind units held in released lots in this partial fragment; not total Site 1000 inventory.

metrics.name: Flowbind policy inventory position (units)
metrics.description: Snapshot sum of open-order, quarantined (including known Quality result) and released Flowbind units. The model does not enforce correct external booking or transfer.

metrics.name: Flowbind reorder flag (0 or 1)
metrics.description: Reports whether the represented snapshot policy position is strictly below the current reorder point; does not place an order.

scenarios.name: Provisional Flowbind policy snapshot
scenarios.description: Agent-assumed 1,200 released, 200 quarantined, 100 open-order units at the 1,500-unit flag boundary. For snapshot accounting only; not a policy-performance simulation. Replace with dated SAP stock.
